Usage: show [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Display a work item without changing context. Cache-only by default; use --refresh to sync first.

Arguments:
  [0] <int?>    Work item ID to display. Omit to show the active work item.

Options:
  -o, --output <string>    Output format: human, json, minimal. [Default: @"human"]
  --tree                   Display as hierarchy tree instead of detail card.
  --refresh                Sync from ADO before displaying, instead of reading cache only.

Examples:
  twig show 1234             Show work item #1234
  twig show 1234 --output json  Show work item #1234 as JSON
  twig show --tree           Show work item tree hierarchy for the active item
  twig show 1234 --tree      Show tree hierarchy rooted at #1234
  twig show --tree --depth 2  Show tree hierarchy limited to 2 levels deep

Usage: new [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Create a new work item in ADO.

Arguments:
  [0] <string?>    Work item type, positionally: twig new task "Write tests". The shipped examples document this spelling.
  [1] <string?>    Title as the second positional argument. Quote multi-word titles.

Options:
  --title <string?>               Title for the new work item. [Default: null]
  --type <string?>                Work item type (e.g., Task, Bug, User Story). [Default: null]
  --area <string?>                Area path for the new work item. [Default: null]
  --iteration <string?>           Iteration path for the new work item. [Default: null]
  --description <string?>         Description text for the new work item. [Default: null]
  --parent <int?>                 Parent work item ID to link under. [Default: null]
  --set                           Set the new work item as the active context after creation.
  --editor                        Open an external editor to fill in fields.
  --format <string?>              Convert --description before sending. Supported: "markdown" (force convert) or "raw" (never convert). Default: auto — convert when System.Description is HTML-typed. [Default: null]
  --field <string[]?>             Set a field at creation time: fieldReferenceName=value. Repeatable. Required for types with required custom fields. Values convert Markdown only for HTML-typed fields (not affected by --format); an explicit --field System.Description overrides --description. [Default: null]
  -o, --output <string>           Output format: human, json, minimal. [Default: @"human"]
  --description-file <string?>    Read the description body from a file instead of --description. [Default: null]
  --description-stdin             Read the description body from piped standard input.

Examples:
  twig new task "Write tests"         Create a new Task under the active item
  twig new bug "Login fails on edge"  Create a new Bug under the active item
